hook t-resize; Tweening a container's width or height when its layout state changes (compact ↔ expanded card, collapsing panel, list row toggling extra detail).
hook t-digit-group; Counters, prices, balances, or any number that updates and should re-enter from a direction with blur.
hook t-badge; A small badge appearing on top of a trigger (bell, inbox, button).
hook t-text-swap; Swapping the text of a status indicator in place: "Processing…" → "Done", "Save" → "Saved".
hook t-dropdown; Contextual menus, dropdowns, popovers: anything that opens from a trigger and should visually grow from that trigger's position.
hook t-modal; Modal dialogs and full-overlay surfaces that scale up from center.
hook t-panel-slide; A panel that slides into view inside an existing container: e.g.
hook t-page-slide; Sliding between two full pages or screens that live side-by-side: list ↔ detail, step 1 ↔ step 2 in a wizard.
hook t-icon-swap; Cross-fading two icons in the same slot: hamburger ↔ close, sun ↔ moon, play ↔ pause, expand ↔ collapse.
hook t-success-check; Confirming a completed action: payment processed, file uploaded, message sent, form saved.

hook t-avatar-group; Hovering an item in a horizontal stack (avatar row, chip group, badge cluster, segmented button) should lift the hovered item, gently lift its neighbors with a power-falloff, then snap everything bac
hook t-input-wrap; Form validation feedback: invalid email, wrong password, missing required field, mismatched confirmation.
hook t-clear; Clearing a text field: search box, filter input, any field with a clear (×) button.
hook t-skel; A placeholder that loads then reveals real content: list rows, cards, profile headers.
hook t-shimmer; A loading / "thinking" label that shimmers: streaming status, "Generating…", any in-progress copy that should feel alive without a spinner.
hook t-tabs; A segmented control / tab bar where the active pill slides between options: view switchers, filter segments, small mutually-exclusive button sets.
hook t-tt-group; A hover/focus tooltip shared by a group of triggers (toolbar buttons, icon rows, avatar stacks).
hook t-stagger; A headline + supporting line that rise into view with staggered blur: hero copy, empty states, onboarding steps.
hook t-tilt; A card / tile / media surface that tilts in 3D toward the pointer while hovered, with a soft light "glare" tracking the cursor across it.
hook t-morph; A small circular trigger (a "+" FAB, a compose button, an add-action affordance) that morphs into the menu / panel it opens instead of popping a separate surface next to it.
hook t-acc; A disclosure / accordion / collapsible section whose panel grows and shrinks in height when toggled, with the header chevron flipping between a downward "v" and an upward "^".
hook t-toast; Toasts, snackbars, and transient confirmations that rise into view from the bottom edge: "Saved", "Copied", "Message sent".
hook t-like; Like / favorite / heart buttons: anywhere a single tap flips a boolean and deserves a tiny celebration.
hook t-learn; "Learn more", "See all", "Continue": inline links or buttons with a trailing chevron that should acknowledge hover.
hook t-check; Checkboxes, to-do completion, multi-select rows: any boolean control where the checked state should feel earned.
hook t-reel; Numbers that change with fanfare: points, prices, follower counts, dashboards KPIs.
hook t-toggle; On/off switches: settings rows, theme toggles, feature flags.
hook t-think; An AI status line that narrates what the agent is doing: "Setting up a workplace", "Running a command", "Browsing files".
hook t-reason; An agent "thinking out loud": a small card plays back a stream of reasoning by stepping the transcript up two lines at a time, holding between steps.
hook t-stream; Model output arriving word by word: chat responses, AI completions, any streamed paragraph.
hook t-matrix; Tiny inline loaders built from a 4×4 matrix of 2px dots.
hook t-stack; Sonner-style banner / toast stacking.
